description: Defines the UnrecognizedProtocolVersionException class for handling specific exception cases related to unrecognized protocol versions in the Laminas Diactoros project.

classes.name: UnrecognizedProtocolVersionException
classes.description: Custom exception class indicating unrecognized protocol versions; extends UnexpectedValueException.

methods.name: forVersion
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of UnrecognizedProtocolVersionException with a message indicating the unrecognized version.
